atomic_statement_summary: The constant 1/8 in the non-IID entropy lower bound can be improved to 1/2.
notes: Explicitly stated as the authors' belief and as a conjecture; no proof is claimed.

atomic_statement_summary: As ell tends to infinity, the variance of the left-prime truncation has the stated logarithmic-square asymptotic.
notes: The special m=1, b(T)=T formula is an immediate specialization of the same expected asymptotic, not a heterogeneous second conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The necklace formula extends to cactus block-adjacency shadows with annular cyclic blocks and arbitrarily nested tree components under nesting-aware admissibility.
notes: A complete conditional proposition in the author's explicit 'What remains open' conjecture; theorem and definition cross-references supply its established local notation.

atomic_statement_summary: A site and monoidal comonad should model CPTP channels, their tensor product, and a commutative classical core.
notes: Despite the conjecture label, 'built from' finite-dimensional C*-algebras, a 'suitable' category, and the statement that tensor products 'correspond' are not defined tightly enough to delimit a mathematical proposition; this is a construction program rather than a stable release claim.

atomic_statement_summary: For all sufficiently large m, consecutive Ruzsa numbers differ in absolute value by at most one.
notes: The authors call this their revised conjecture, cite numerical support, and explicitly say they cannot currently attack it.

atomic_statement_summary: A trained transformer's distributional effective Lipschitz constant is claimed to be polynomial in corpus entropy and much smaller than its worst-case constant.
notes: No asymptotic family or variable is specified for O(poly(H)) or 'concentrates well below'; 'near-zero', typical inputs, and the perturbation regime are also unquantified. The record additionally bundles empirical argument, conditional bounds, and proof-sketch prose, so no exact stable proposition is extractable.

atomic_statement_summary: For every genus at least two, a geometric open r-spin potential exists and equals the stated specialization of phi_g.
notes: The g=0 and g=1 cases are known, but the single all-genera g>=2 proposition is explicitly conjectured and open.

atomic_statement_summary: For fixed dimension g and number field K, the geometric etale fundamental group of every corresponding Neron model has uniformly bounded order.
notes: The paper proves finiteness and the elliptic case but explicitly leaves uniform boundedness in general dimension as its conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The mean-square variance of primes in intervals of length H is asymptotic to H log(X/H), uniformly in the stated range.
notes: This is a self-contained, author-labeled restatement of the classical Goldston-Montgomery conjecture, not a mere bibliographic pointer.

atomic_statement_summary: The open parts assert nonclosure on simply connected Dirichlet or Robin domains and Robin examples on doubly connected domains.
notes: Retain exactly the open subclaims: (1) 'Consider the Laplacian on a bounded regular planar domain Ω with Dirichlet or Robin boundary conditions. Then the nodal line of any second eigenfunction cannot be closed if Ω is simply-connected.' (2) For Robin boundary conditions, 'there exist doubly-connected domains for which the nodal line is closed and does not touch the boundary.' Drop the Dirichlet doubly-connected existence clause, which the authors say their previous paper already proves.

atomic_statement_summary: The block mixes proved parity and bottleneck results with the open adversary-tightness equality.
notes: Claims (i) and (ii) are proved, while only the adversary equality in (iii) remains open. This older mixed formulation overlaps the precise [Conjectured] item extracted from id 1801, which is the retained representative.

atomic_statement_summary: For fixed k>=4 and L>k, sufficiently large n-vertex graphs with circumference at most L maximize C_k copies at H(n,L).
notes: This is one coherent universal extremal formula. Even-k and C5 cases are known, but the universal conjecture remains open for odd cycles beyond C5.

atomic_statement_summary: The special-cycle generating series Theta_A_n is a Chow-valued holomorphic modular form of weight 2n for SL_2(Z).
notes: The survey explicitly labels the complete proposition as a conjecture and records only cohomological and low-dimensional partial results.

atomic_statement_summary: Every d-dimensional zonotope admits a (1±epsilon) zonotopal approximation with O(d/epsilon^2) generators.
notes: A self-contained restatement of Talagrand's long-standing conjecture; the paper proves only a special Delta-modular case.

atomic_statement_summary: Every exponent beta_j in the relevant Iwasawa elementary decomposition equals one.
notes: The author explicitly identifies this as Greenberg's semisimplicity conjecture and says little evidence is known.

atomic_statement_summary: Successive twin-period pairs for reversible cellular automaton 115 obey the stated affine recurrence in p with parity correction.
notes: The authors explicitly say they cannot prove this recurrence and prove only a weaker statement.

atomic_statement_summary: No non-CM elliptic curve over Q has a p-coincidence for any prime p>=5.
notes: Computational verification in the LMFDB is evidence only; no general proof is claimed.

atomic_statement_summary: The rainbow Hamiltonicity bias threshold is asymptotic to n^2/log n.
notes: Presented as an explicit final-section conjecture without a proof.

atomic_statement_summary: For a quantum disc, log K(t)/log t converges in probability to 1/2.
notes: The paper conjectures the quantum-disc exponent after proving more general heat-content convergence, not this value.

atomic_statement_summary: In every non-torsion monoid, each nonempty subset of integers greater than one occurs as a finite power-monoid length set.
notes: The survey's 'Into the future' section poses this complete statement as a conjecture and discusses only partial progress.

atomic_statement_summary: Under the stated weaker endpoint hypotheses on psi, the selected BBM velocity has the standard square-root-two limit and pi-squared logarithmic correction.
notes: The author explicitly says the coupling does not prove this weaker-condition result and records it as a conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The coefficients of rho(q) obey the stated strict residue-class sign law for every n>=21.
notes: This exact cutoff is not proved by the paper's eventual sign theorem. It is related to the stronger finite sign-and-zero conjecture id 4212 but is not an exact semantic duplicate.

atomic_statement_summary: The only open item is tightness of the adversary quantity at the proven graph eccentricity 2N-3.
notes: Retain exactly item (iv): 'The adversary quantity is tight: γ_adv = γ_graph = 2N-3.' Drop items (i)-(iii), which the source explicitly marks proved, and drop the following consequence using the already-proved Q_LV formula. This is the preferred precise representative over duplicate mixed id 1800.

atomic_statement_summary: For every epsilon>0, only finitely many abc triples have quality exceeding 1+epsilon.

atomic_statement_summary: For every positive multiple k of three, no subset of (Z/kZ)^2 meets every axis-parallel or diagonal line in exactly two points.

atomic_statement_summary: No connected graph exhibits multi-edge Laplacian matching-root integral variation.

atomic_statement_summary: On a suitable open subset of the intersection of two flag nilradicals, all induced quotient maps have Jordan types given by the relative-position growth diagram.

atomic_statement_summary: In the stated Q-factorial Kahler family with canonical fibers, the central canonical class is pseudo-effective exactly when every noncentral fiber's is.

atomic_statement_summary: The two-color size Ramsey number of arbitrary star forests equals the stated sum of extremal pairwise arm-size parameters.

atomic_statement_summary: Assuming RH and simple zeta zeros, the stated weighted second moment over zeros is asymptotic to T/(2pi).

atomic_statement_summary: For every n>=1, the numerator and denominator subsum polynomials are coprime.

atomic_statement_summary: Every t-intersecting permutation family has size at most the largest canonical A_k family, with equality only for its two-sided translates.

atomic_statement_summary: BV-BFV quantization of Chern-Simons theory on the cylinder agrees with shifted deformation quantization of Loc_G(S^1).

atomic_statement_summary: The two bounded-weight universal-cycle constructions are equivalent and the resulting cycle admits O(1)-amortized symbol generation.

atomic_statement_summary: Every graph H of treewidth two has graph-bootstrap percolation running time M_H(n)=O(n).

atomic_statement_summary: Every digraph either half-integrally packs k directed cycles of distinct lengths or has a bounded vertex deletion leaving only boundedly many cycle lengths.

atomic_statement_summary: Every smooth word over a mixed alphabet has language C_f^infinity and hence the stated common factor complexity.

atomic_statement_summary: For all relevant n,p,q, the recursively defined group J_n^{p,q} equals the automata transformation group K_n^{p,q}.

atomic_statement_summary: Every connected Cayley graph on a finite group of order at least three is Hamiltonian.

atomic_statement_summary: Every planar graph satisfies Wegner's stated tight piecewise upper bound on its square chromatic number as a function of maximum degree.

atomic_statement_summary: For general datasets with more than two points, the selected-bundle matter energy diverges with exponent 2nu-n as two oppositely labeled points coalesce.

atomic_statement_summary: The induced planar Turán number of P6 equals the stated piecewise function of n.

atomic_statement_summary: For k=3,...,d+1, the random hitting angles for chromatic number above k and for a spherical neighborhood-complex witness coincide with probability tending to one.

atomic_statement_summary: For every m>=3, the m=2 irreducibility equivalence extends to the multi-cocycle superelliptic Heisenberg algebra with the stated generalized admissibility condition.

atomic_statement_summary: An optimal expert-library decomposition is claimed to place chunk boundaries at local conditional-entropy maxima.

atomic_statement_summary: For every fixed orientable surface Sigma, SimplePin(Sigma,4) is NP-complete.

atomic_statement_summary: For each k and all large n, a maximum half-sized family of n-subsets of [2n] exists with no balanced subset through size 2k but one of size 2k+2.

atomic_statement_summary: For multiples k of three, the torus extremal density is strictly below the infinite-grid density.

atomic_statement_summary: If 8n+9 is not represented by x^2+2y^2, then t_o(n) is even.

atomic_statement_summary: For every k>=2, the k-robust clique complex of a square-sequence graph is a wedge of (2k-3)-spheres.

atomic_statement_summary: The class of poset tournaments is dichromatic-number bounded.

atomic_statement_summary: The remaining claim is irreducibility of the induced M-type quantum-affine Whittaker modules outside the proved A_1^(1) case.

atomic_statement_summary: Every finite coloring of the natural numbers contains a monochromatic Pythagorean triple.

atomic_statement_summary: For finite Γ, the gain-graph matroid class M(Γ,Γ1,A) has finitely many excluded minors.

atomic_statement_summary: A bundle predicts the exact maximum spanning-tree count and characterizes all maximizers at projective-plane orders.

atomic_statement_summary: The coefficients c(n) have unbounded positive and unbounded negative excursions.

atomic_statement_summary: For tree-like and tree-necklace shadows, a reduced tangent-angle realization minimizing conflict number attains the minimum Gauss load after redundant turns are removed.

atomic_statement_summary: The ELX conjecture gives an exact Hermitian-variety intersection maximum and characterizes its extremal hypersurfaces.

atomic_statement_summary: Every ordered Chomp triple has at most one nonnegative fourth coordinate extending it to a P-position.

atomic_statement_summary: Every family of log abelian varieties over a log-smooth base satisfies the stated Néron mapping property for log-smooth morphisms.

atomic_statement_summary: For every positive p, the critical L^p-mean meta-Fibonacci recursion satisfies Q(n)~√(2n).

atomic_statement_summary: For every nontrivial strong Fraïssé class, one Borel code separates all associated Cohen generics from all compatible invariant-measure-random generics.

atomic_statement_summary: An iff bundles a proved polynomiality range with the conjectural non-polynomiality of its complement.

atomic_statement_summary: The full motive of every hyper-Kähler variety is an abelian motive.

atomic_statement_summary: A quotient-surface resolution is a generic-theta moduli space exactly when the maximal resolution dominates it.
notes: Semantically equivalent to id 2640 in the same source. Retain id 2640 as the more complete formulation and reject this duplicate.

atomic_statement_summary: Infinitely many hyperbolic rational homology three-spheres have first coexact one-form eigenvalue greater than two.
notes: Explicit author conjecture; the proved families have substantially smaller known limit points.

atomic_statement_summary: Any generalized crossing change that preserves a knot type must occur at a nugatory crossing.
notes: A self-contained form of the cosmetic crossing conjecture, with only special cases known.

atomic_statement_summary: The normalized minimum size s(n)/(n log n) for universal graphs for trees has a limit.
notes: The paper gives upper and lower bounds but explicitly leaves limit existence as a conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: For 1<=q<=2<=p, the complex Banach-Mazur distance between finite-dimensional l_p and l_q equals the stated power n^alpha.
notes: The source proves n=2 only; the all-n exact formula remains the explicit conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: In the stated double-cover setup, the two displayed equivariant matrix-factorization categories are equivalent.
notes: The author calls the categorical equivalence expected and gives geometric motivation, not a proof.

atomic_statement_summary: Every bounded-degree graph satisfying CD(0,infinity) has polynomial volume growth with exponent controlled only by maximum degree.
notes: The paper proves the edge-regular subclass but not the explicitly conjectured general graph statement.

atomic_statement_summary: For p>1, equality in the centered planar L_p Rogers-Shephard corollary occurs only for parallelograms with a vertex at the origin.
notes: The authors explicitly conjecture this equality characterization and do not establish it.

atomic_statement_summary: A generic affine realization of a multi-oval Schwarz component is claimed to make each oval's exterior Cauchy transform nonalgebraic.
notes: The block begins with a proved lemma, leaves 'generic affine Euclidean realization' and stability unspecified, and continues through conjectural-picture and expectation prose. These layers do not yield a clean stable source proposition for strict release.

atomic_statement_summary: For fixed entry bound d, box-constrained integer programs whose two-nonzero-per-row matrix has a tree graph are polynomial-time solvable.
notes: Explicit conjecture, noted to be unknown even when the graph is a path.

atomic_statement_summary: The matching-free r-uniform hypergraph extremal number obeys the stated maximum of the clique and star constructions.
notes: A self-contained statement of the classical Erdős Matching Conjecture, known only in partial parameter ranges.

atomic_statement_summary: The odd-partition numerator evaluated at -1 is o(n!).
notes: A precise asymptotic conjecture in the paper's open-questions section.

atomic_statement_summary: The remaining open clause maps generalized cluster monomials to classes of simple modules under the Grothendieck-ring isomorphism.
notes: Retain exactly: 'Moreover, the generalized cluster monomials are mapped to classes of simple modules.' Drop 'For l≥2, the Grothendieck ring of C_{ε,ξ} is isomorphic to a generalized cluster algebra of rank 2l−2,' because the source says it proves that first clause.

atomic_statement_summary: For any flow on the hyperfinite II_1 factor, cocycle conjugacy to the model flow, the Rokhlin property, strict outerness, and full Connes spectrum plus outerness are equivalent.
notes: Known implications and the almost-periodic case are partial results toward one coherent all-flows equivalence.

atomic_statement_summary: A smooth submanifold nondegenerate inside a Hypothesis-D affine subspace has convergent-Gallagher induced Lebesgue measure.
notes: The affine-subspace theorem does not prove the explicitly conjectured inheritance by relatively nondegenerate submanifolds.

atomic_statement_summary: For every Master-Hit, the canonical integer xi^2+eta^2 is never a square.
notes: The Pythagorean-triple phrasing is exactly equivalent, and the paper uses rather than proves the conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: The paper asks whether every linear image of the Schatten-1 ball has uniformly bounded volume ratio.
notes: Presented solely as 'Is it true...?' in an open-problems list, with no author conjecture, expectation, or belief asserted.

atomic_statement_summary: For every a>1/2, the Robin Morse index is two in mode |k|=0 and zero in all modes |k|>=2.
notes: The two mode-index clauses are a coherent decomposition conjecture; the total index/nullity sentence is their consequence with a proved |k|=1 result.

atomic_statement_summary: The extending triples for 4-by-n Chomp have a modular structure with fundamental period 112.
notes: Retain exactly: 'The set of triples (a,b,c) that extend to 4×n P-positions exhibits modular structure with fundamental period 112.' Drop the separate 79%-accuracy logistic-classifier sentence; it is an underspecified empirical observation, not a stable conjectured proposition.

atomic_statement_summary: Every connected n-vertex graph has burning number at most ceiling(sqrt(n)).
notes: A self-contained statement of the central Burning Number Conjecture; only special and asymptotic results are cited.

atomic_statement_summary: For G(n,1/2), the expected Lovász theta value is asymptotic to sqrt(n).
notes: The authors explicitly call the precise asymptotic open and conjecture it.

atomic_statement_summary: For every polygon, valenced link pattern, and kappa in (0,8), a unique global valenced multiple SLE_kappa exists.
notes: The source proves kappa=4 and selected patterns only, then explicitly conjectures the full range.

atomic_statement_summary: The CRIM game on integer partitions has the stated piecewise Sprague-Grundy value for every n.
notes: One coherent piecewise value conjecture based on data, with no full proof.

atomic_statement_summary: Every triple of partitions has an integral Stanley-sum rule whose evaluation computes its Jack Littlewood-Richardson coefficient.
notes: The source labels this general structural existence statement a conjecture and does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Competing random-walk ranges in a beta-stable domain of attraction have the stated marginal and joint scaling limits.
notes: Marginal and joint convergence are one coherent vector-limit conjecture; the paper proves only the simple symmetric-walk case.

atomic_statement_summary: Every Riemannian manifold diffeomorphic to S^3 contains four distinct embedded minimal two-spheres.
notes: Known for bumpy or positive-Ricci metrics only; the self-contained general Yau conjecture remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every origin-containing centrally symmetric convex body satisfies the stated sharp L_p Rogers-Shephard volume bound, with equality for the cube.
notes: The inequality and equality example form one coherent sharp conjecture; available theorems cover only special settings.

atomic_statement_summary: The Hartshorne-Rao module of a general union of r skew lines in P^3 has the strong Lefschetz property.
notes: The authors explicitly believe the observed pattern continues and label the all-r statement a conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: Every smooth Fano variety satisfies (i_X-1)rho_X<=dim X, with equality exactly for a product of projective spaces.
notes: The full Mukai conjecture is self-contained here; the paper proves only its special ambient-embedding class.

atomic_statement_summary: The limiting derangement proportion among 123-avoiding permutations is 9/16.
notes: Explicitly reported as Pantone's numerically supported conjecture, without a proof.

atomic_statement_summary: Assuming RH and simple zeros, the sum of 1/|zeta'(rho)|^2 through height T is asymptotic to 3T/pi^3.
notes: A self-contained statement of Gonek's conjecture; cited lower bounds do not yield the asymptotic.

atomic_statement_summary: For any two matrices, two unitary conjugates of their q-symmetrized absolute values dominate the q-symmetrized absolute value of their sum with constant sqrt(2).
notes: The authors explicitly recall this complete inequality as Zhang's strong conjecture and give no resolution.

atomic_statement_summary: For all sufficiently large n, M_3(n)=binom(n-1,3)+n-3.
notes: The authors conjecture that their construction's lower bound is sharp; no eventual upper-bound proof is given.

atomic_statement_summary: Below the accumulation point, c_b is unobstructed exactly for ratios b=m/d arising from the specified mutation data.
notes: A precise iff classification explicitly posed as a conjecture and not proved.

atomic_statement_summary: For every k, sufficiently large minimum out-degree forces k vertex-disjoint directed cycles of pairwise distinct lengths.
notes: The paper presents Lichiardopol's complete conjecture as famously open.

atomic_statement_summary: On every vertex-nonamenable graph, simple random walk has a positive linear range constant.
notes: The referenced definition makes the claim precise; bounded-degree and uniformly transient cases do not settle it generally.

atomic_statement_summary: For identical nonzero angular-momentum blocks and small L relative to the variance scale, the invariant-basis dimension has the stated local-limit asymptotic with O(N^-5/2) error.
notes: Numerics support the estimate, which the authors explicitly say they could not prove.

atomic_statement_summary: For log-concavity index quadruples, both the A-module and C-module tensor products admit the displayed FI-sharp module inclusions.
notes: The two parallel inclusions are one coherent equivariant log-concavity conjecture; verification through degree 19 is partial.

atomic_statement_summary: Every algebraic relation among multiple zeta values follows from comparison of the extended shuffle and stuffle maps via regularization.
notes: A self-contained statement of the central IKZ conjecture; the paper does not resolve it.

atomic_statement_summary: Every admissible finite collection of positive-slope integer linear forms is simultaneously prime for infinitely many integer arguments.
notes: The paper states and assumes Dickson's conjecture to derive consequences; it does not prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: Every graph satisfies lsfw(G)<=2 lrw(G)+2.
notes: The general affine upper bound is explicitly conjectured; the paper establishes only the lower direction and level-one cases.

atomic_statement_summary: The maximum K3,3- and Q3-bootstrap-percolation running times both grow as n^(3/2+o(1)).
notes: The two graph cases form one coherent exponent prediction; current upper and lower bounds do not meet.

atomic_statement_summary: With high probability, every width-m two-layer network fitting random labeled data has Lipschitz constant at least c√(n/m) for any Lipschitz activation.
notes: A complete statement of the Bubeck–Li–Nagaraj conjecture; this paper reaches it only up to a logarithmic factor for piecewise-linear activations.

atomic_statement_summary: The partition coefficients c(n) satisfy the three displayed infinite families of mod-4 and mod-8 congruences.
notes: The three congruence families are one coherent source-block conjecture; k=0 and related special cases do not settle all k.

atomic_statement_summary: At every point x, the spherical-Hecke support of the specified discrete automorphic-function space lies in the rational locus R_{q_x,O,Q}.
notes: The paper treats this support containment as open. It is an exact coefficient-field reformulation of id1474 outside this reviewed part.

atomic_statement_summary: For n≥5, K(n,p,q) maximizes λ1+λ2 among n-vertex graphs, with equality only for that graph.
notes: A complete self-contained extremal conjecture attributed to earlier authors; the known 8n/7 bound does not prove this sharper value and equality classification.

atomic_statement_summary: No infinite finitely generated solvable group satisfies a generalized identity whose length is square-free.
notes: The authors' constructions cover lengths with squared prime factors, leaving this complementary claim open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every ergodic Z^d-nilsystem has the stated discrete-spectrum plus subtorus-Haar-absolutely-continuous Koopman decomposition.
notes: A precise spectral-decomposition conjecture; only lower-dimensional or special cases are established.

atomic_statement_summary: A threshold k1 separates the two displayed asymptotic formulas for the rainbow r-uniform Turán quantity.
notes: The two parameter regimes jointly form one threshold conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: A master package asserts an extended BV–BFV/Reshetikhin–Turaev TQFT equivalence across circle, surface, and cobordism levels.
notes: The block nests a separate circle conjecture, the already-proved AKZ surface theorem, cobordism compatibility, and a large diagrammatic program. It is not a single strict-conjecture release unit.

atomic_statement_summary: For algebraic z, Γ(z) is algebraic exactly when z is a positive integer.
notes: A full self-contained Lang–Rohrlich-type conjecture; cases such as Γ(1/5) remain unresolved.

atomic_statement_summary: Under the stated weight ordering and dimension bound, the selected even periods, equivalently the associated Rankin–Cohen brackets, are linearly independent.
notes: A complete conjecture retained from prior work that includes current authors; the two formulations are equivalent, not separate claims.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated IndCoh-to-IndL equivalence is B-linear and compatible with Wilson/Hecke operators.
notes: Toda reasserts a conjecture from his prior joint work and proves only the GL2 reduced-locus case here.

atomic_statement_summary: All stated D- and I-functions for a general n-triangulated polygon are Laurent polynomials whose coefficients are all one.
notes: The n=1,2 verifications are special cases; the general multiplicity-free statement remains open.

atomic_statement_summary: Every symmetric convex region in R^d has maximal sum-free density at most one half.
notes: The authors explicitly state their belief; the claim is open even for centered Euclidean balls.

atomic_statement_summary: The expected Lovász theta number of a random dense circulant graph is asymptotic to √n.
notes: Presented as a numerical-evidence-based conjecture; only partial bounds are known.

atomic_statement_summary: For every n, the complex Banach–Mazur distance between l1^n and l∞^n equals √n.
notes: Known for n=2,3 only. This is a semantic special case of the broader id390 elsewhere in part-01, so flag for subsumption rather than treating it as an exact duplicate.

atomic_statement_summary: No closed aspherical manifold admits a Riemannian metric of positive scalar curvature.
notes: A complete statement of the classical Gromov–Lawson conjecture, used as the basis for the paper's extension.

atomic_statement_summary: Every projective complex log Fano pair has a uniform positive lower bound for its Frobenius-alpha invariant over all sufficiently large reductions.
notes: The authors formulate this equivalent reduction-theoretic version. It is semantically equivalent, up to the stated dimension shift, to id2812 outside this reviewed part.

atomic_statement_summary: Every graph of maximum degree at least nine with no maximum-size clique is (Δ−1)-choosable.
notes: A self-contained restatement of the Cranston–Rabern list-coloring conjecture; the cited partial results do not settle the general graph case.

atomic_statement_summary: The displayed conjecture gives weak monotonicity in the restricted-set size, while its prose incorrectly calls that decrease strict.
notes: Exact retained subclaim: 'For any graph G and fixed k, [G k]_1 ≥ [G k]_2 ≥ … ≥ [G k]_k.' The accompanying phrase 'decreases strictly' would require > and must not be silently merged with the displayed weak inequalities.

atomic_statement_summary: The stated signed quadratic form is positive on every nonzero primitive degree-i element.
notes: Only the non-mixed i=1 case is proved. An equivalent analytic reformulation appears as id4274 outside this reviewed part.

atomic_statement_summary: Every log-concave measure has isoperimetric constant comparable from below to its halfspace value, equivalently at least a universal constant over √||A||op.
notes: A full statement of the KLS conjecture; the two displayed bounds are presented as equivalent formulations.

atomic_statement_summary: The essential image of the q-monodromic Shv(G)-module composition is exactly the objects whose underlying AGCat object comes from DGCat.
notes: An explicit author conjecture removing a dualizability assumption.

atomic_statement_summary: The Pontryagin dual of the p-primary Selmer group over K∞ is a finitely generated torsion Λ-module.
notes: A complete statement of Mazur's classical conjecture; known special cases do not settle it in general.

atomic_statement_summary: The ILW scattering data obey the stated semiclassical Weyl law, norming-constant asymptotics, and beyond-all-orders reflection bound.
notes: These linked assertions form one coherent all-open scattering-data conjecture; the constructed soliton-ensemble theorem does not prove them for the original data.

atomic_statement_summary: Every diameter-two product-maximizing n-gon has the conjectured odd regularity or even symmetry and diameter-graph structure.
notes: The three parity and structure clauses coherently describe the same class of extremizers.

atomic_statement_summary: Every representation satisfying the stated oddness, irreducibility, conductor, determinant, and finite-flat hypotheses arises from a weight-two mod-p eigenform of the predicted level.
notes: A complete special case of Serre modularity over number fields, stated as a conjectural input rather than a pointer.

atomic_statement_summary: The maximum number of K_{t,t} copies in an n-vertex K_{2,t+1}-free graph is asymptotic to n²/[2t(t−1)].
notes: The authors conjecture that their upper bound gives the true asymptotic.

atomic_statement_summary: The Sylow-p subgroup of the random bipartite sandpile group converges to the stated odd-p or p=2 distribution.
notes: The parity cases form one limiting-distribution conjecture supported computationally.

atomic_statement_summary: Every automorphism of both P(Z) and its reduced large power monoid P0(Z) is inner.
notes: The two monoid clauses form one coherent rigidity conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: Apart from the circular uniform law, no circular distribution family remains in the same family after every r≥2 subsampling operation regardless of step-length law.
notes: An explicit uniqueness conjecture that the paper says its methods do not settle.

atomic_statement_summary: The reciprocals of the zeros of the Hua–Pickrell entire-function diffusion solve the displayed infinite-dimensional stochastic differential equation.
notes: The authors explicitly formulate this singular ISDE representation as conjectural.

atomic_statement_summary: A two-sided logarithmic-growth package has a proved positive liminf and an open finite-limsup half.
notes: The paper proves the first displayed clause. Exact retained subclaim: 'For every δ∈(0,1), limsup_{N→∞} φ_δ(N)/log(N)<∞.'

atomic_statement_summary: For α≥1 and f in B1(α), every coefficient a_n with n≥2 satisfies |a_n|≤2/(n−1+α).
notes: A precise coefficient-bound conjecture, not proved by the related results in the paper.

atomic_statement_summary: Every nontrivial K4-free graph with independence number at least n/3 satisfies λ1²+λ2²≤4m/3.
notes: The sufficiently-large-n result is only a special case of this all-n statement.

atomic_statement_summary: Pixton's 3-spin relations generate all tautological Chow and cohomology relations on both stable and compact-type curve moduli spaces.
notes: The two moduli-space equalities form one coherent completeness conjecture; the paper proves only new special cases.

atomic_statement_summary: For every q>0, the pulled-back L2 metric on the stated higher direct image is good in Mumford's sense.
notes: A universal goodness conjecture extending the paper's partial metric results.

atomic_statement_summary: The optimal Fourier-spectrum threshold for a full-dimensional distance set is 1+(d/2−1)θ.
notes: The following distance-set implication explicates the proposed threshold rather than adding a separate conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: For every commutative unital ring, finiteness of p2 is equivalent to finiteness of one, and hence every, even-degree Pythagoras number.
notes: A complete cited conjecture; proofs for fields and selected rings do not establish the universal equivalence.

atomic_statement_summary: The even part of the subsum numerator polynomial num(n,x) is unimodal.
notes: One of two separate experimental conjectures; this row contains the complete first claim.

atomic_statement_summary: The three stated Tutte-type nowhere-zero Z5-, Z4-, and Z3-flow conjectures all hold under their respective connectivity and minor hypotheses.
notes: The paper presents the three still-open classical flow statements as one coherent package.

atomic_statement_summary: Antipodal two-colorings of a hypercube have the stated monochromatic or one-switch antipodal paths and geodesics.
notes: The four named clauses form a coherent hierarchy of the Norine/Feder–Subi/Leader–Long hypercube conjectures.

atomic_statement_summary: A partition has Conway pair (0,1) exactly when it is an even-by-even hook.
notes: A complete structural equivalence conjecture; the adjacent (1,0) item is a separate question and is not included in this row.

atomic_statement_summary: For every smooth symmetric cost satisfying the stated symmetries, the normalized permanent has Pal's exponential/Fredholm-determinant asymptotic.
notes: A full statement of Pal's conjecture; this paper proves only the block-constant case.

atomic_statement_summary: An iff combines the established obstruction outside small-diameter trees with the open DOM-boundedness of all such trees.
notes: The preceding text proves that connected H not a tree of diameter at most 3 cannot yield a DOM-bounded class. Exact retained subclaim: 'If H is a tree of diameter at most 3, then forb(H) is DOM-bounded.'

atomic_statement_summary: Under either displayed small-time or small-budget condition, every budget-constrained strategy asymptotically almost surely fails to create K5.
notes: The authors believe their upper-bound regime is sharp and state this missing implication as a conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: Adding a pendant vertex to any connected H makes the maximum running time either bounded or of the same order as for H.
notes: A precise asymptotic dichotomy stated as a strengthening conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: Every sufficiently large r-uniform s-connector satisfying the stated size inequality arrows the prescribed colored matching vector.
notes: An exact quantified hypergraph generalization proposed by the authors.

atomic_statement_summary: The text asks whether ker ρ is trivial and asks for the image of ρ for a general Coble surface.
notes: Both sentences are interrogative research questions; no author-labeled truth-apt proposition is stated.

atomic_statement_summary: The multivariate period module D_B(V) is finitely presented.
notes: A concise paper-local proposition explicitly labeled conjecture; later consequences assume rather than prove it.

atomic_statement_summary: The coefficient sequence of den(n,x) is log-concave for every n except 3,5,6,7.
notes: A complete experimental log-concavity conjecture.

atomic_statement_summary: For every admissible weight w other than six, Y_{w,2}(z) is completely positive.
notes: The authors explicitly conjecture the all-weight positivity beyond their computed evidence.

atomic_statement_summary: Every admissible shifted Plücker coefficient sequence is nonnegative and log-concave.
notes: Nonnegativity and log-concavity jointly form the paper's coherent positivity conjecture; the displayed inequalities merely unpack it.

atomic_statement_summary: The expected heat trace of a quantum disc has the stated area leading term and a negative t^(−1/2+o(1)) correction.
notes: The general theorem suggests the exponent but does not apply to the random quantum-disc setting; the authors say this case remains unproved.
